MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The outdoor mounting tape fits my recent anchors and screws because it could help secure a lightweight accessory, provided the surface and load are suitable.",
    "Its outdoor use connects with my recent outdoor deck screws, although I would choose it only for a suitable mounting job."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The heat shrink tubing, relay harnesses and battery lugs require wiring projects that my recent fastening purchases do not suggest.",
    "Buying vacuum bags reflects a specific replacement need; it does not give me a reason to buy a bathroom scrubber.",
    "The glue, epoxy and grinder wheel require repair or equipment needs I have not shown, and a ten-pack of glue is more than I currently need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in workshop supplies, when the actual job each item serves matters more to me.",
    "Outdoor screws seem to have been stretched into interest in marine electrical supplies, even though weather resistance alone does not make those useful for my projects."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of nails, screws and anchors point toward fastening and mounting tasks, with specific sizes and tool compatibility mattering to the choice.",
    "I buy some items for narrow replacement needs, such as vacuum bags, rather than as an invitation to explore related cleaning products.",
    "I need a concrete current use and a suitable quantity before choosing another supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my mounting needs but stretched them into unrelated wiring, cleaning and repair projects."
}
